title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/js/go + parity fixes and bump v1.31.0
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: SDK ergonomics and behavioral parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go have drifted while shipping streaming and retry features independently. This patch unifies the public ergonomics for authentication, unified retry/backoff behavior, and streaming consumer APIs across all three SDKs so customers get consistent behavior and fewer cross-language surprises. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a common 'AuthProvider' interface and language-specific shims so token refresh + credential chaining is consistent; 2) Centralize retry/backoff policy configuration and surface a single 'RetryPolicy' that supports exponential, constant and jittered backoffs with sensible defaults; 3) Stabilize streaming SDK APIs to match the hosted API semantics (connect, open, events, error mapping, and cancellation hooks); 4) Apply parity fixes identified in ENG-3499 (error codes, retryable flagging for 429/5xx, and streaming disconnect semantics); 5) Small ergonomics improvements (typed responses in TS, context/cancel support in Go, async-friendly helpers in Python); 6) Version bumps to v1.31.0 across python/js/go packages and release notes. Testing and rollout: unit + integration test suites added for all SDKs; end-to-end smoke tests against staging runtime; canary rollout to 10% of traffic for hosted API clients. Backwards compatibility: default behaviors are backward compatible, but advanced users who customized retry policies should verify their policies with the new RetryPolicy API. Checklist: - [x] API design review with SDK owners - [x] Cross-language tests green - [x] Docs updated in redwood-docs - [x] Release notes included - [x] QA smoke tests passed

review_comments: Evan Chen: Please make sure the RetryPolicy default keeps previous exponential jitter values; observed a small difference in unit tests initially. Author response: adjusted constants to match previous behavior and added a compatibility test.

Lena Rodriguez: In TS streaming, the 'data' event payload was previously unwrapped; will this change break consumers? Author response: we added a compatibility wrapper that emits both legacy and new shaped events; documented in migration notes.
Markus Vogel: Go cancel semantics look good but add an example to the README. Author response: added code snippet and an integration test demonstrating context cancellation.
CI bot: unit tests failed on first run (TS lint); reran after fix and all checks passed.
release_notes: v1.31.0 - SDKs: Unify auth, retry, and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Notable: new AuthProvider abstraction, centralized RetryPolicy with backward-compatible defaults, stabilized streaming event semantics, parity fixes for retryable error flags, and minor ergonomic helpers across languages. See docs/sdks/retries.md for migration details.
